title.en: "Name three deep cuts or get out"

summary.en: Gatekeeping with a discography. Hits are still how most people arrive.
summary.zh: 拿碟谱当门禁。热歌仍是大多数人的入口。

body.en:
Real version of the joke: someone online grades your taste because you like the single. Deep cuts come after obsession—not before entry.

Metal forums, shoegaze Discords, and Britpop group chats all run a version of this quiz. Steal the homework if you want; do not treat it as a visa stamp. Start with the landmark track. Anyone who mocks that is insecure with a spreadsheet.
body.zh:
真实版本：你喜欢那首单曲，网上就有人给你品味打分。深切是着迷之后才找到的——不是入场券。

金属论坛、自赏 Discord、Britpop 群聊都有这套测验。想抄作业可以；别当签证盖章。先听 landmark。嘲笑这个的人，是带着 Excel 的心虚。

note.en: Creep fans vs OK Computer thesis writers—same band, eternal fight.
note.zh: Creep 粉 vs OK Computer 论文党——同一支乐队，永久内战。

note.en: Master of Puppets or nothing—until someone admits Enter Sandman.
note.zh: 不认 Master of Puppets 就不算——直到有人承认听 Enter Sandman。
